L1746@P40: 3.5.1 Testing

L1748@P40: be identified and addressed by validating one or more of the system components and the operability of the
L1749@P40: plan. Testing can take on several forms and accomplish several objectives but should be conducted in as
L1750@P40: close to an operating environment as possible. Each information system component should be tested to
L1751@P40: confirm the accuracy of individual recovery procedures. The following areas should be addressed in a
L1752@P40: contingency plan test, as applicable:
L1753@P40:  Notification procedures;
L1754@P40:  System recovery on an alternate platform from backup media;
L1755@P40:  Internal and external connectivity;
L1756@P40:  System performance using alternate equipment;
L1757@P40:  Restoration of normal operations; and
